findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: data_quality_check · Private data: workspace_create, workspace_token_rotate, workspace_revoke, workspace_list, contract_create, contract_get, contract_publish, contract_compare, contract_history, contract_validate, monitor_create, monitor_status, monitor_history, monitor_revoke, json_format, json_diff, json_to_csv, json_schema_validate, data_quality_profile, data_quality_check, quality_policy_create, quality_policy_publish, quality_policy_get, quality_policy_evaluate, quality_policy_history, handoff_evaluate, handoff_get, handoff_history, data_normalize · Public sink: contract_publish, monitor_create, data_quality_check, quality_policy_publish · Destructive: json_format, data_quality_check, handoff_evaluate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: data_quality_check · Private data: workspace_create, workspace_token_rotate, workspace_revoke, workspace_list, contract_create, contract_get, contract_publish, contract_compare, contract_history, contract_validate, monitor_create, monitor_status, monitor_history, monitor_revoke, json_format, json_diff, json_to_csv, json_schema_validate, data_quality_profile, data_quality_check, quality_policy_create, quality_policy_publish, quality_policy_get, quality_policy_evaluate, quality_policy_history, handoff_evaluate, handoff_get, handoff_history, data_normalize · Public sink: contract_publish, monitor_create, data_quality_check, quality_policy_publish · Destructive: json_format, data_quality_check, handoff_evaluate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
